faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CMO Chitrakoot Medical Officer (MBBS) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the CMO Chitrakoot Medical Officer (MBBS) recruitment is 19th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification required for the Medical Officer (MBBS) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree from a recognized institution by MCI and have registration from MCI/State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer (MBBS) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies announced for the Medical Officer (MBBS) post in the CMO Chitrakoot recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the CMO Chitrakoot Medical Officer (MBBS) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer (MBBS) position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the CMO Chitrakoot Medical Officer (MBBS) recruitment will be held on 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Chief Medical Office Chitrakoot (CMO Chitrakoot).

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Medical Officer (MBBS) post?
faq.answer: The Medical Officer (MBBS) posts are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of CMO Chitrakoot, and a link is provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
